# AI Sarthi Tech

> AI Sarthi Tech is a software business in Gurugram, India. It makes the Interview Sarthi apps: four AI tools, one for each step from job search to client meetings. Every app is free to start; paid passes run for a fixed time and never renew by themselves. Plans, prices, help and downloads are on interviewsarthi.com.

## The apps

- [Apply Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/apply/): a Windows app that finds jobs that fit your CV on different job portals, fills in each application and sends it, every day. Free applications every week.
- [Prep Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/): an AI voice mock interviewer in the browser (phone or computer) that asks about your own CV and the job you want, follows up on weak answers, scores every answer and shows a stronger one. Free demo interview, no sign-up.
- [Live Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/live/): an AI interview assistant that listens to the interviewer's question and shows a suggested answer based on your CV during the interview. On a Windows 10/11 PC or on your phone. Free minutes to start.
- [Meeting Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/meeting/): a Windows app for client and work calls: live captions and a recap after every call for free, plus short replies from your own project notes.
